paragraphs.text: Zihir Wola is Zimone Wola 's father on Arcavios .

Zihir is a sentimental and emotional person. He is described as "whimpering beside the doorway" when Zimone is introduced to her new room, indicating that he is emotionally affected by his daughter growing up. He is concerned for Zimone’s well-being, reassuring her that he and Dipo are just down the hall, which shows his protective nature. When Dipo objects to Zimone going to Strixhaven , Zihir takes weeks to convince him that Zimone can protect herself, indicating that he is persuasive and persistent.

Zihir Wola reacted sentimentally to milestones in his daughter Zimone 's life, such as when she got her room at age seven. Zihir successfully convinced his husband Dipo to allow Zimone to attend Strixhaven , showing his belief in her abilities. Additionally, Zihir was involved in the storytelling about his mother Nimiroti Wola , hinting at a complex family history that he shared with Zimone in whispered snippets.
